entities.summary: Prince Heinrich Wilhelm Adalbert of Prussia was the son of Prince Wilhelm of Prussia and Landgravine Marie Anna of Hesse-Homburg. He was a naval theorist and admiral. He was instrumental during the Revolutions of 1848 in founding the first unified German fleet, the Reichsflotte. During the 1850s, he helped to establish the Prussian Navy.
